prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Settings now shows dated credit history beneath the balance, with signed amounts and clear refund labels in English and Korean. Type-checking passed.

@@ -0,0 +1,251 @@
+from uuid import UUID
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi import FastAPI
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.api.v1.endpoints import project_workflow
+from app.core.errors import AppException, ErrorCode
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Asset, Character, CreditTransaction, CustomStyle, Episode, Project, StoryCut, Workspace
+from app.services.ai import ai_service
+from app.services.billing import billing_service
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini, PNG
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def story(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    response = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    project_id = UUID(response.json()["id"])
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        project = session.get(Project, project_id)
+        workspace_id = project.workspace_id
+        character = Character(project_id=project_id, name="Driver", consistency_seed=1)
+        episode = Episode(project_id=project_id, title="Pilot", episode_order=1)
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=1, script="Bus arrives", selected_layout="Square", aspect_ratio="1:1")
+        style = CustomStyle(workspace_id=workspace_id, name="Ink", description="Black ink", status="failed")
+        session.add_all([character, episode, cut, style])
+        ids = dict(project=project.id, character=character.id, episode=episode.id, cut=cut.id, style=style.id)
+        session.commit()
+    return headers, workspace_id, {key: str(value) for key, value in ids.items()}
+
+
+def assert_billing(workspace_id, charges):
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace_id).credits == 500 + sum(charges.values())
+        entries = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction).where(
+            CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id,
+            CreditTransaction.amount < 0,
+        )).all()
+        assert sorted((entry.action_type, entry.amount) for entry in entries) == sorted(charges.items())
+
+
+BACKGROUND_CASES = [
+    ("/projects/{project}/cover", {}, "generate_project_cover_image", -15, Project, "project", "cover_image_status"),
+    ("/projects/{project}/art-style", {"art_style": "Ink"}, "generate_project_cover_image", -15, Project, "project", "cover_image_status"),
+    ("/characters/{character}/generate", {}, "generate_character_sheet", -20, Character, "character", "sheet_status"),
+    (
+        "/projects/{project}/characters/casting/generate",
+        {"character_id": "{character}", "name": "Driver", "description": "A bus driver", "style": "Ink"},
+        "generate_character_sheet", -20, Character, "character", "sheet_status",
+    ),
+    ("/styles", {"name": "New Ink", "description": "Black ink"}, "style_sample_generation", -10, CustomStyle, None, "status"),
+    ("/styles/{style}/regenerate", {}, "style_sample_generation", -10, CustomStyle, "style", "status"),
+    ("/episodes/{episode}/cuts/{cut}/generate-image", {}, "bg_generate_cut_image", -8, StoryCut, "cut", "image_asset_id"),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("outcome", ["exception", "empty", "success"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path,body,action,cost,model,id_key,field", BACKGROUND_CASES)
+def test_background_ai_billing(client, story, monkeypatch, outcome, path, body, action, cost, model, id_key, field):
+    headers, workspace_id, ids = story
+
+    calls = []
+
+    def generate(*args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(args)
+        # The request has queued the work, but the job has yet to save a result.
+        assert_billing(workspace_id, {})
+        if outcome == "exception":
+            raise RuntimeError("AI unavailable")
+        return b"" if outcome == "empty" else PNG
+
+    method = {
+        "generate_project_cover_image": "generate_project_cover_image",
+        "generate_character_sheet": "generate_character_sheet",
+    }.get(action, "generate_image")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ai_service, method, generate)
+
+    request_path = "/api/v1" + path.format(**ids)
+    request_body = {key: value.format(**ids) for key, value in body.items()}
+    if model is StoryCut:
+        # The main router matches the unbilled episode endpoint first.
+        workflow_app = FastAPI()
+        workflow_app.include_router(project_workflow.router, prefix="/api/v1")
+        with TestClient(workflow_app) as workflow_client:
+            response = workflow_client.post(request_path, headers=headers, json=request_body)
+    else:
+        response = client.post(request_path, headers=headers, json=request_body)
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    succeeded = outcome == "success"
+    assert_billing(workspace_id, {action: cost} if succeeded else {})
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        resource_id = ids[id_key] if id_key else response.json()["id"]
+        value = getattr(session.get(model, UUID(resource_id)), field)
+        if model is StoryCut:
+            assert (value is not None) == succeeded
+        else:
+            assert value == ("completed" if succeeded else "failed")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path,body,method", [
